title: Cold Storage: The Faces We Left Behind
description: Cold Storage cyber-noir adventure for Altered Carbon RPG 2.4: 74 authored journals, 16 controlled evidence handouts, 8 pregens built with the system's Character Creator rules in non-clone 5th-8th sleeves, 46 archived sleeve records (2 contested), 160 relationship links, ready-to-roll Chapter 7 adversaries, GM Continuity & Psychosurgery Console sharing the system's Baggage workflow, optional Fray, 140 noir emblems for every Altered Carbon item, network and opponent, story journals in the Altered Carbon look with one-click checks into GM Control, 14 zoned noir maps with walls, doors and windows wired to the system's zones, one-click scene setup with every NPC, rival and threat in place, and an Investigation Tracker with live mission panels in the GM journals and a players' Case File. Foundry 14 live QA outstanding.
